mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_posts SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, category, title, content, view_count as viewCount, comment_count as commentCount, tags, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM community_posts WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
